gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: 'Started five years ago' → present perfect with 'for'.

gaps.lead: After a year in Paris, the pace of life feels normal to her.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to + noun/-ing = become accustomed to; present perfect for present result.

gaps.lead: He jogged every morning when he was younger.
gaps.sentence: He ___ every morning when he was younger.
gaps.explanation: 'Used to + infinitive' describes a past habit.

gaps.lead: The concert was cancelled because hardly anybody came.
gaps.sentence: The concert was cancelled ___ people came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.

gaps.lead: Barbara's parents were certain that she would be a great tennis player.
gaps.sentence: Barbara's parents were ___ that she would be a great tennis player.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.
